metadata.name: MSS Technical Terminology Dictionary (English -> Tamil)
metadata.purpose: Curated, human-readable terminology reference for MSS Tamil localization -- Final Localization Release Gate, Parts 4 and 5. This file is the authoritative reference for consistent MSME/government terminology. It is a curated subset; the full machine-usable dictionary (all reusable terms, states, districts, keywords) is catalog/translation_dictionary.json, which this file's entries are also mirrored into (via ta_dictionary.py TERMS/KEYWORDS_TA) so the same terms are used consistently by the actual translation pipeline, not just documented here.
metadata.note: Preferring natural government/business Tamil terminology over literal phonetic machine translation, per instruction -- e.g. 'Capital Subsidy' = 'மூலதன மானியம்', never a transliterated 'கேபிடல் சப்சிடி'.

categoryA_transliterationAllowed.description: Common, high-frequency acronyms transliterated into Tamil script for user-facing display and search. Used as-is in localization.ta content and as Tamil search-keyword variants.

categoryB_preserveOfficialAbbreviation.description: Official scheme/institution abbreviations kept unchanged in Tamil text -- never transliterated, never translated. IDs and catalog references are never modified regardless of category. A parenthetical Tamil gloss may be added for user comprehension, e.g. 'CGTMSE (கடன் உத்தரவாத திட்டம்)' -- the gloss explains the term, it does not replace the abbreviation.

terms.glossExample: PMEGP (பிரதம மந்திரி வேலை வாய்ப்பு உருவாக்கத் திட்டம்)
DPIIT (தொழில் மற்றும் உள்நாட்டு வர்த்தக மேம்பாட்டுத் துறை)

relationToPipeline.technicalTerms: Mirrored into catalog/ta_dictionary.py's TERMS dict (whole-string/compositional translation) and KEYWORDS_TA dict (single-token search-keyword translation) -- the actual dictionary translate() consults, not a documentation-only copy.
relationToPipeline.categoryA: Mirrored into KEYWORDS_TA as lowercase single-token entries (msme/gst/emi) so any scheme whose search.keywords.en includes these tokens gets the matching Tamil keyword automatically on the next localization pipeline run.
relationToPipeline.categoryB: Deliberately NOT added to TERMS as a blanket substitution -- these abbreviations must keep appearing verbatim in ordinary prose (protected via ta_dictionary.py's ACRONYMS mask/protect list, unchanged by this file). The glossed form is available for a consumer that explicitly wants it, not auto-applied everywhere the abbreviation appears.
relationToPipeline.fullMachineDictionary: catalog/translation_dictionary.json (457 entries as of this version) is the complete, pipeline-consumed dictionary artifact; this file is the curated, human-readable reference the task asked for and stays in sync with it for the terms listed above.
